pros: Simplicity and ease of use, less overwhelming than competitors.
Centralized communication (message boards, chat) keeps discussions in one place.
Efficient and intuitive task creation and management (to-dos, assignments, due dates).
Flat pricing model (historically) for unlimited users is appealing to growing teams.
Focus on clear communication and getting work done, rather than complex features.
Reliable and stable platform with minimal downtime.
cons: Limited features compared to other project management tools, lacking advanced functionalities.
Restrictive free plan and pressure to upgrade for basic project needs.
Project setup can be tedious, requiring manual addition of each tool.
Lack of robust reporting, analytics, or time tracking capabilities.
UI/UX inconsistencies or dynamic layout shifts can lead to misclicks or confusion.
Poor integration between different tools (e.g., events not showing to-dos without a dedicated calendar tool).

pros: Simple and intuitive interface, making it easy to get started without a steep learning curve.

Streamlined communication features keep team discussions organized within projects.

Efficient task management with easy drag-and-drop reordering and inline editing.
Clear visibility of assigned tasks and due dates for individual team members.
cons: Limited customization options for project views and workflows compared to competitors.
The free plan is very restrictive, pushing users to upgrade quickly.
Basic reporting and analytics capabilities, making it hard to track overall project progress.
Lack of robust integrations with other essential business tools.
Initial project setup can feel manual, requiring tools to be added one by one.
Calendar functionality is not always comprehensive or intuitive for tracking all project events.

obs: - [friction] The Free plan allows 1 project and a blank 'My Project' is pre-created, so visiting New project redirected straight to the upgrade/plans page; I had to reuse 'My Project' as the client project.

- [friction] A new project is completely blank and every tool (To-dos, Docs & Files, Calendar) must be added one by one from the plus menu; my clicks on Docs & Files and Calendar while the menu stayed open after adding To-dos did not add those tools.
- [friction] Clicking the 'To-dos' title on the project card put it into rename mode (Save / Never Mind) instead of opening the tool.

- [benefit] The to-do form shows Assigned to, When done notify, Due on, Notes and Subtasks inline, and after saving one to-do it immediately opens a blank one so pressing Enter after typing a name added Beta and Gamma in one action each.
- [benefit] Typing 'Sam' in Assigned to gave an autocomplete chip in one click, and the saved to-do shows the assignee and due date as compact chips beside the name.
- [friction] Picking a due date inserted a new Repeat row that pushed the 'Add this to-do' button down, so a click aimed at its old position missed.
- [benefit] Dragging the handle on the left of Demo Gamma moved it from third to first in a single drag with no confirmation.
- [benefit] Clicking the date chip on a to-do opened an inline editor with a date picker, and changing Oct 21 to Oct 28 took two clicks (date, Save).
- [friction] My Events showed only 'No events today' for October and did not list the to-do due Oct 28, so it was not usable to check project progress by date without a project Calendar tool.
